Confidence bands for a VCMoE fit

Source: R/confband.R
vcmoe_confband.Rd

Pointwise intervals and finite-grid simultaneous bands for the coefficient functions of a fitted VCMoE model, from the local sandwich covariance.

Usage

vcmoe_confband(
  fit,
  data = NULL,
  level = 0.95,
  type = c("pointwise", "simultaneous"),
  coefficient_set = c("expert", "gating", "sigma", "theta"),
  strict = TRUE,
  control = list(),
  cluster = NULL
)

Arguments

fit

A vcmoe fit with k = 2:10.

data

Optional original data frame. The current implementation uses the data stored in fit$fitted; refit with keep_data = TRUE if needed.

level

Confidence level.

type

Interval columns to expose as lower and upper.

coefficient_set

Coefficient blocks to return.

strict

Whether weak local fits should return blocked intervals.

control

Optional inference controls. Without cluster, the covariance is HC0 and the simultaneous band uses the analytic Epanechnikov path critical value; simultaneous_method = "multiplier_coefficient_path" calibrates each coefficient over the complete fitted grid by a Gaussian multiplier bootstrap instead. With cluster, covariance_adjustment may be "CR0", "CR1", "CR2" (default) or "CR3", and simultaneous_method "wild_cluster_path" (default) or "multiplier_coefficient_path". multiplier_B (default 199) sets the number of bootstrap draws and seed their random seed. path_tests = TRUE adds the zero and constancy path tests described below; path_sets, a named list of grid-index vectors, adds bands and tests over sub-paths (for example the interior grid points).

cluster

Optional atomic vector of independent-cluster identifiers (for example donors), one per retained fitted row, in fitted-row order (not the original unfiltered order). If named, names must match the retained design-matrix row names exactly. Missing IDs are rejected.

Value

A vcmoe_confband object with interval and diagnostic data frames; with cluster, cluster_support reports per-component cluster support, and with path_tests = TRUE, tests holds the path-test statistics and p-values.

Details

Independent observations. HC0 sandwich intervals with normal critical values. For engine = "joint_path_em", the covariance is the observed local-likelihood sandwich evaluated at the joint-path estimate; it does not include shared-path, label-selection, or finite-grid cross-grid responsibility uncertainty, so joint-path convergence and the returned score-imbalance diagnostics should be inspected.

Clustered observations. With cluster, kernel-weighted scores are summed within clusters. Cluster inference supports unrestricted local-grid fits that retain their data. Coefficients and the penalized bread are unchanged. CR0 uses normal critical values. CR1 scales by G / (G - 1) with t(G - 1), for G clusters with positive kernel weight at the grid point. CR2 (bias-reduced linearization in score space) and CR3 (one-step cluster jackknife) use Bell-McCaffrey degrees of freedom under a working model of independent observations within clusters; both use cluster Hessian blocks. The default simultaneous band studentizes Webb-weighted wild cluster score draws with the same adjustment at every grid point; one weight per cluster is shared by all grid points and coefficients. When the number of distinct Webb weight vectors, 6^G, is at most multiplier_B, all of them are used. Clusters must be independent; smoothing bias and bandwidth selection are not corrected. With fewer than 20 clusters, or fewer than 10 effective clusters, at a grid point a warning flags the intervals as sensitivity analyses.

Paths and tests. A band covers one coefficient's complete fitted grid, not a continuous domain or all coefficients jointly. A blocked grid point blocks that coefficient's complete-path band, not its other pointwise intervals; a band over a sub-path in path_sets remains available. With path_tests = TRUE each complete path also gets two sup-t tests from the same bootstrap draws as its band: beta(u) = 0 (the band-inversion test) and beta(u) constant, which contrasts each grid estimate with the path mean and studentizes the contrast with the same small-cluster adjustment. These tests are the recommended constancy tests for clustered data; the likelihood-ratio test of vcmoe_glrt() assumes independent observations.
